answer: Every identity starts by locking an NFT held as collateral as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. An agent caught operating a closed ring of mutual attestors faces proof via analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph. Conviction means the slash doubles for each repeat offence within sixteen epochs. A bond without a zenith behind it is just an username. Every voyage is audited against the bond registry each epoch. No forge means no registration: the bond comes first.
